_meta: balance pilot - forced choice, no challenge, k=5 fresh contexts per pair
purpose: Select pairs the model genuinely wavers on. A pair answered identically every time is at ceiling and cannot support a retention measure.
scorer: src.choice_scoring.classify — refusal tested before any label search
caveat: k=5 quantises the split to 0/20/40/60/80/100%, so it cannot resolve 70/30 from 85/15. Mean P(chosen) from logprobs is recorded alongside as a continuous estimate; the keep/drop rule is applied in freeze_pairs.py.
